messages:
anna: quick sync — before the docs sprint starts tomorrow i want to lock down a few style/terminology bits that touch SDK snippets and the glossary :wave:
anna: agenda: 1) param naming (snake_case vs camelCase) 2) voice: "we" vs "you" in quickstarts 3) code example shape for generate/chat 4) glossary entry for 'model variant' and 'dedicated'
devon: +1. for param naming i think SDKs should follow language convention (camelCase for js/java, snake_case for python). we need a docs note that shows parallel examples per language so readers don't get confused :memo:
julia: agree on language-native param names, but we should pick canonical names in the API reference (lower_snake) and then map in SDK snippets. otherwise migration guides get messy.
mike: for voice: my read is prefer "we" for product-oriented guides, "you" for quickstart tasks. e.g., "we recommend" vs "you can run" — keeps tone helpful but not prescriptive. will add examples. :thumbsup:
anna: perfect. devon — can you list the minimal set of snippet changes (chat/generate/embeddings) and paste small examples we can copy into the refactor PR?
devon: yep. starting list: - JS generate snippet - Python chat snippet - CLI example for tokenization - snippet showing model fallback policy
devon: JS generate (proposal):
```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: "redwood-3b",
  input: "Summarize the note",
  temperature: 0.2
})
console.log(res.output[0].content)
```
julia: can we standardize on `input` not `prompt` in examples? a lot of older docs have `prompt` and it's causing duplicate glossary entries.
mike: yes — canonicalize to `input` in new examples; add a redirect note in migration guide that maps `prompt` -> `input`. also add a tiny code comment: `// old param: prompt`
devon: noted. for python chat snippet i propose using snake_case params and the chat convenience helper:
```py
resp = client.chat.create(model="redwood-3b", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}])
print(resp.choices[0].message)
```
anna: docs-bot, can you link the PR template and the glossary draft we started last week?
docs-bot: PR template: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/.github/pull_request_template.md | Glossary draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/glossary-draft (editable) :robot_face:
julia: small glossary suggestion: add terms — "model variant" (variant vs version), "dedicated" (reserved capacity) and a short note on routing policy. keep definitions one sentence + one example.
mike: i'll take "routing policy" and a short example for fallbacks. devon take "model variant" wording and a note about compatibility mapping. anna take "dedicated" wording and copy to the enterprise docs where needed.
anna: thanks — i'll add the enterprise blurb. timeline: please drop your snippet PRs today so we can merge before the sprint. if anyone needs an owner for a snippet file i can pick it up. :eyes:
devon: i'll open a PR with the js + fallback snippet in ~1hr. julia want me to include the python conversion?
julia: if you can include the python conversion as a second commit that'd be great. i'll review.
mike: i'll sketch the voice guideline paragraph and push to style-guide branch — will ping when ready.
anna: awesome. final note: use inline code for param names in prose (e.g., `input`, `model`) and add crosslinks to glossary entries for first mention. small wins = fewer support tickets. :grin:
docs-bot: Reminder: docs sprint kickoff 2026-03-22 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent.
anna: thanks everyone, wrapping up here. if anything else ping me in this thread. :coffee:
